onb.err.pending: This part is being switched on. You can keep going.
onb.lang.hint: The app runs in Spanish for now; we keep your preference for when English lands.
onb.s1.title: Before we start
onb.s1.sub: Your birth year and language. Ten seconds.
onb.s2.title: Pick 3 interests
onb.s2.sub: They order your daily pick and what we show you first.
onb.s2.max: Three is the limit. Remove one to swap.
onb.s3.title: You're in
onb.s3.sub: One WhatsApp link and the banter starts in 30 seconds.
onb.s3.gift: Welcome gift: +1 Shield for your streak
onb.s3.avatar: This is how they'll see you
onb.s3.avatarHint: Tap to change. No photos, no fuss.
onb.s3.joinBody: Did someone send you a Vinko link? Open it and you're straight into their group or pool. No codes, no extra steps.
a2hs.title: Vinko on your home screen
a2hs.body: Open it like an app: full screen, one tap away.
a2hs.ios: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
empty.group.title: Nothing here… yet.
empty.group.body: Create the group's first pool and let the banter begin.
empty.groups.title: No groups, no banter.
empty.groups.body: Create one and share the link on WhatsApp. People do the rest.
empty.inbox.title: Inbox on mute.
empty.inbox.body: When someone beats you, challenges you or settles your pool, you'll hear it here.
empty.porras.title: You haven't predicted anything yet.
empty.porras.body: Your first pool takes 30 seconds. Less than picking where to eat.
empty.created.title: Zero pools created.
empty.created.body: Every group has someone who organises. Today it's you.
empty.ranking.title: Empty leaderboard.
empty.ranking.body: Nobody has got one right yet. Good moment to be first.
empty.resolved.title: Blank page.
empty.resolved.body: Your hits and misses will live here. For now, neither.
empty.search: No trace. Try another word or create the pool yourself.
empty.hoy: No daily pick today. Come back tomorrow or make your own.
empty.feed.title: Quiet feed.
empty.feed.body: Someone has to break the ice. Create a pool and pass it on.
